title: Rembg: Unauthenticated SAM model injection permits local-file disclosure through malicious ONNX graphs (CVE-2026-115924)
description: Rembg versions prior to 2.0.82 have an unauthenticated vulnerability in the /api/remove endpoint that allows attackers to inject malicious SAM models via the extras.sam_model parameter. This enables path traversal and placement of crafted ONNX models that read arbitrary local files and encode their contents into returned PNG images. The flaw allows disclosure of any file accessible by the rembg process, including sensitive files like /etc/passwd. The issue is fixed in version 2.0.82.
